name: Virag Clean Human Design Engine
globalRule: CLEAN HUMAN DESIGN — FINAL AUTHORITY. Every output must feel deliberately made by a skilled human graphic designer: one clear idea, strong hierarchy, generous breathing room, optical alignment, controlled contrast, restrained effects and believable material detail. Remove every element that does not improve the message. Clean means intentional—not empty, generic or template-like.

contentBudgets.clean: Use one short hook of two to five words, the exact product or brand name only when needed, and no more than two compact supporting facts. Add a CTA only when the user supplies one. No paragraphs, filler microcopy or duplicate wording.
contentBudgets.light: Use the exact product or brand name plus one supplied fact. Keep the total copy extremely short.
contentBudgets.balanced: Use one short hook plus two or three exact supplied facts in compact modules. No body paragraph.
contentBudgets.rich: Use one short hook plus four to six exact supplied facts, but distribute them with strong whitespace and clear grouping. Never invent copy to fill space.

fontSystem.rule: Typeset all added copy as a separate clean 2D design layer. Use actual, named, professional font behavior with correct glyphs, kerning, baselines, line breaks and optical margins. Use a maximum of two font families and three weights. If optional copy cannot be rendered accurately, remove that optional copy instead of inventing or warping letters.
pairingRules: Use one display family and one highly readable supporting family.
Use sentence case or restrained uppercase according to the brand; never mix many casing styles.
Keep tracking, line height and line breaks consistent.
Never place important text across busy photographic detail.

hierarchy: zero to two supporting information modules
one restrained footer only when required
layoutSystem.spacing: Use a consistent spacing rhythm, generous outer margins, clean alignment lines and optical—not merely mathematical—centering.
layoutSystem.graphicBudget: Use one dominant graphic device and up to two supporting devices. Prefer blocks, rules, frames, masks or subtle texture with a clear functional role.
layoutSystem.colorBudget: Use the exact brand colors plus one supporting neutral and at most one trend accent. Maintain strong text contrast.
layoutSystem.imageCraft: Use believable photography or controlled CGI, natural scale, coherent perspective, grounded contact shadows and subtle real-world imperfection.

categoryRules.Creative: Create a clean, post-ready 4:5 Instagram design with one memorable concept, one clear product hero and a compact information hierarchy. It must not resemble a cinematic poster or a generated product render with text added afterward.
categoryRules.Flyer: Use clear reading order, short information groups, disciplined margins and one prominent action or event detail. Remove decorative clutter before delivery.
categoryRules.3D: Keep the CGI concept simple enough to understand instantly. Use physically coherent materials and one spatial idea; the social layout, copy and typography must remain clean and human-designed.
categoryRules.Packaging: Use practical shelf hierarchy, accurate print behavior and controlled materials. Show only necessary information and never add fake regulatory copy or ornamental complexity.
categoryRules.Video: Use clean shot design, motivated camera movement, natural timing and concise typography cards. Each shot must communicate one thing; remove transitions or effects that do not advance the message.

rejectIf: too much text or more information modules than the brief needs
random stickers, badges, blobs, arrows or decorative shapes
generic gradients, neon glow, particles, smoke, splashes or lens effects
centered product on a pedestal without a concept reason
overly glossy, plastic or visibly AI-generated surfaces
perfect template symmetry with no optical adjustment
duplicate product name, claim or CTA
any change to the locked product
